ai.title: Admin UI for org-specific model config
ai.summary: Added admin interface to manage organization-specific model configurations via new API routes and UI components. Includes `checkAdminAuth` middleware for security and `ModelConfigSheet` for selecting finetuned Vertex models. Database interactions use Drizzle ORM with upsert logic on `orgFeature` table. Adopted `@tanstack/react-query` for data fetching in web package.

eli5.text: Administrators can now adjust which AI models are available to a specific organization directly through a new section of the admin dashboard, rather than only through code changes. Behind the scenes, this required adding a new protected admin page, a way to fetch and save each organization's model settings in the database, and a confirmation step so only authorized staff can make these changes. If you looked at the admin interface today, you would see a new menu option for managing organization models that did not exist before.

ai.title: Remove updatedby field from org feature route
ai.summary: The `updated_by` field is removed from the `orgFeature` upsert logic in `web/src/app/api/admin/orgs/[orgId]/features/[feature]/route.ts`. This change aligns the code with the current database schema, which lacks the `updated_by` column. The modification ensures that feature configuration updates proceed without attempting to write to a non-existent field.

eli5.text: When someone updates a feature setting for an organization, the system no longer tries to record who made the change. This only matters internally and does not affect anything you see or interact with. If you looked behind the scenes, you would notice the update process skips a field that was previously attempted but never stored in the database. The system now avoids a small error that happened because it was saving something the database was never set up to keep.

ai.title: Checkpoint logic handles nested git repos and missing git CLI
ai.summary: CheckpointManager now throws CheckpointsDisabledError if git CLI is unavailable. file-manager adds gitAddAllIgnoringNestedRepos to temporarily rename nested .git dirs to .git.codebuffbackup during staging, preventing isomorphic-git errors. hasUnsavedChanges filters out ' M ' status lines to ignore modified submodules. gitAddAll excludes **/*.codebuffbackup paths.

eli5.text: The assistant now requires the Git command-line tool to be installed before it can save checkpoints, and it disables checkpoint features gracefully with a clear message if Git is missing instead of crashing. It also handles projects that contain smaller, nested repositories by temporarily hiding their inner Git folders during checkpoint operations so they don't cause errors. Modified nested repositories won't be mistaken for unsaved work, and temporary backup files are excluded from being recorded as changes. These improvements keep the checkpoint feature stable for projects with nested repository structures and missing Git installations.
